name: AI Tools ROI
description: Verifies host.createRoi / removeCreatedRoi through AI write tools.
author: automator

aiTools.name: list_roi_uids
aiTools.description: List the ids of the ROIs on the current tile.

aiTools.name: make_roi
aiTools.description: Create an elliptical or rectangular ROI around the first ROI of the current tile (verification of host.createRoi). mode "lps" reuses the LPS center returned by the previous call, shifted by dz.

dz.description: Offset along z in lps mode (mm); a large value is expected to be rejected as off-slice.

mode.description: Center source: px = centroid of the first ROI, lps = previous result.

aiTools.name: make_bidirectional
aiTools.description: Create a long-axis/short-axis (Bidirectional) ROI around the first ROI of the current tile (verification of host.createRoi tool Bidirectional). Axes are drawn in pixel coordinates from the first ROI centroid.

tiltDeg.description: Rotation of the long axis from the row direction (degrees).

skewDeg.description: Deviation of the short axis from perpendicular (degrees); a non-zero value is expected to be rejected as bad-axes.

aiTools.name: remove_roi
aiTools.description: Remove a ROI this plugin created (verification of host.removeCreatedRoi).
